context.transcript:
Thanks for inviting me to your radio station to talk about my clothing designs.
You know, I'm always asked about my inspiration.
Well, my friends inspire me the most.
When starting to design clothes, I talk to them as much as possible.
I want to know how they want to feel.
Because clothing designs aren't just about art.
They're also about psychology.
That's why I wrote New Clothes, New Me.
It describes how our clothes affect your self-image and your attitude.
Actually, I'll be at Horton's Bookstore this Saturday signing books.
I hope to see many of you there.
context.transcript_translation:
感谢您邀请我到您的电台来谈论我的服装设计。
你知道，人们总是问我关于我的灵感来源。
嗯，对我来说，朋友们是最大的灵感来源。
当我开始设计衣服时，我会尽可能多地和他们聊天。
我想知道他们希望感受到什么。
因为服装设计不仅仅是艺术。
它也关乎心理学。
这就是我写《New Clothes, New Me》的原因。
它描述了我们的衣服如何影响您的自我形象和态度。
实际上，这个周六我会在 Horton's Bookstore 签售书。
希望在那里能见到很多人。
